summary: Frontend UI/UX upgrades verified end-to-end on https://growth-funnel-8.preview.emergentagent.com. All 10 batched components are wired and functioning: ScrollReveal wraps StatsBar/Insights, MagneticCta wraps Hero/Footer/BigCTA/CaseStudy/ROI buttons, CrosshairCursor toggles html.custom-cursor-on, SocialProofToaster shows rotating messages at bottom-left (hidden on mobile via 'hidden md:block'), LiveTicker has animate-marquee element, PressShelf shows all 6 wordmarks (TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company, Bloomberg, Inc., WSJ), ROI Calculator has 3 sliders + email->Inquiry flow, BigCtaCard renders with owl + correct title, CaseStudyModal opens from each portfolio item with KPIs/desc/quote/Start-a-similar-project CTA (which closes modal then opens Inquiry), 404 page renders with owl/'404 · OFF THE RADAR'/'Lost in the noise.'/'Back to base'. index.html has correct <title>, favicon /owl-logo.jpg, OG/Twitter meta tags. Zero console errors and zero pageerrors during full traversal.

issues: Owl word-mark inside the floating dashboard tile overlaps the 'noise.' headline at narrow viewports — see screenshot. The MarketingBackdrop (HeroVisual + AnalyticsCard) sits behind the typography on mobile and partially obscures readability of the headline. Consider hiding the backdrop below md or pushing it lower in z/layout on mobile.

action_items: (Polish, optional) On mobile <md viewport, the AnalyticsCard/HeroVisual overlaps the H1 headline; consider hiding or repositioning on small screens for readability.

(Code-quality, optional) CrosshairCursor toggles html.custom-cursor-on regardless of pointer-fine; visual element correctly uses 'hidden md:block' so user-facing behavior is fine, but the global class still applies on mobile. Consider gating with matchMedia('(pointer:fine)').
critical_code_review_comments: App.js (123 lines) — clean wiring; activeCase state for CaseStudyModal correctly drives open prop and resets on close.
CaseStudyModal — body overflow:hidden lock on open + restore on unmount/close; outside-click via onClick on backdrop with stopPropagation on inner — verified working.
RoiCalculator — onSubmitLead receives {email, revenue, roas, spend, lift} and properly opens Inquiry dialog with the email passed as service text; submit-then-success state flips correctly.
MagneticCta wrapping the hero/footer/big-cta/case-study buttons does not block pointer events — clicks pass through to inner <button>.

All listed data-testid attributes exist and match request: hero-cta, hero-section, live-ticker, press-shelf, roi-section, big-cta-card, big-cta-title, big-cta-book, portfolio-item-{obsidian,neon,halo,vault}.
index.html: favicon links (3x), OG (title/description/image/site_name/type), Twitter (card/title/description/image), <title> and theme-color all correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only landing page (no backend changes this pass). Public URL: https://growth-funnel-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Inquiry dialog is shadcn Dialog ([role=dialog]) opened via Home-level state (inquiryOpen + inquiryService). CaseStudyModal uses framer AnimatePresence with z-[100] backdrop and stops propagation on inner. ROI sliders use native input[type=range] inside .roi-slider — note that React controlled-input testing requires native setter dispatch (regular el.value+input event won't flip React state); verified via UI screenshots that lift number animates on user drag.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring fix. Two minor cosmetic/code-quality observations noted in action_items.
